scope: Observable troubleshooting checks and transparent user-input arithmetic; no firsthand hardware testing or measured performance claims.

supports: Display input/cable/output checks
CPU-support and BIOS verification
Recommended memory slots and one-module check
Graphics-card seating and required power connections
sources.implementationLimits: Exact model manuals override general steps. No pin shorting, socket cleaning, guessed CMOS/BIOS procedure or automatic defect diagnosis was introduced.

supports: Persistent labeled CPU/DRAM/VGA/BOOT indicators
Recommended RAM configuration
Storage connections
sources.implementationLimits: LEDs are investigative indicators, not proof of a failed component. Colors and model behavior are not assumed universal.

supports: CPU and required-BIOS support list
EZ Debug LED observation
Documented minimal POST and reconnecting one item at a time
sources.implementationLimits: Keep cooling installed, preserve a required discrete GPU, disconnect power before internal work. Board-specific minimal configuration must be verified in its documentation.

supports: Disk initialization applies to a new empty disk
Existing data must be protected
Initialization and formatting are separate from firmware detection
sources.implementationLimits: Unknown data state follows the data-protection branch. Tool does not initialize, format, repair or inspect a drive.

sources.access: Full official page and timing definitions read
supports: CAS cycles × 2000 ÷ DDR MT/s
CL, tRCD and tRP are timing-cycle counts
Profiles exceed standard settings and need supported platforms
sources.implementationLimits: Tool calls output CAS interval rather than complete system access latency. Optional timings remain unknown; timing arithmetic is not FPS or stability evidence.

sources.access: DDR, MHz, MT/s, memory-channel and Speed sections read
supports: DDR transfers on both clock edges
MT/s is twice clock frequency in MHz
Peak module rate from MT/s × 8
sources.implementationLimits: Output identifies a theoretical 64-bit data path and does not infer active channel count or measured system throughput.

supports: GB and MB use decimal prefixes
GiB and MiB use powers of two
A byte contains eight bits
sources.implementationLimits: Copy duration = manually entered bytes divided by manually entered effective bytes/second. Extra allowance is an explicit user choice, not a statistical range.

existingFeatureDecisions.decision: Preserved; already includes width and height, so no duplicate screen-size calculator created.
Preserved and linked; new comparator adds two-kit comparison, optional tRCD/tRP and separate rate/interval reporting.
Preserved and linked; new transfer planner serves duration rather than capacity.
Extended existing route; original low-FPS, stutter and driver checklists remain present.

privacy: No hardware auto-detection, network requests, notes analytics or automatic persistence. Local path saving needs an explicit checkbox and save action; restore/remove/export are visible controls.
integration: After program-site.cjs and before continuation-site.decorate, seo-pass and program-routing manifest: require('./growth-tools.cjs')({root,records,images,shell,write,esc}). Generator changes only /troubleshooting/, /tools/, its two new tool routes, tool assets, shared search index and growth-tool-metadata.json.

verification.browserQA: Parent integration must inspect desktop/mobile, both themes, branch/back/reset/save/restore, decimal transfer input and both calculator results.
